messages:
maria: Quick smoke results for equinox14b (14B) int6 vs int8 — posting raw notes so we can make a routing/canary decision. TL;DR: int6 wins on unit cost (≈2.1x cheaper vs fp16, ≈1.5x vs int8) but shows a measurable hit on longform coherence. Propose hybrid routing + small fp16 safety fallback. Full details below.

jon: ran microbench on 4k context, batch=8 (simulated consumer chat mix). Numbers: int6 p50=40ms p95=280ms throughput=135k tok/s/node; int8 p50=36ms p95=262ms throughput=160k tok/s/node. Token-cost estimate (relative): fp16=1.0, int8=0.68, int6=0.46.

lee: quality snapshots: short QA (1-turn) EM drop is tiny: int8 -0.3 pts, int6 -0.8 pts. Longform summarization (avg 3 paragraphs) ROUGE-L: fp16 45.2, int8 44.1 (-1.1), int6 43.4 (-1.8). We also saw higher repetition in int6 outputs on long form. Example output attached in thread (copied below).

august: product note — for GTN this matters: short QA latency/cost dominates transactional usage, longform is high-value and sensitive to coherence. We probably want default int6 for chat and an explicit routing rule for longform/summary flows. Also want monitoring hooks for regression in rouge/hallucination.

ops-bot: deploy: equinox14b-int6 canary cluster created (eqx-canary-1713005012). Canary traffic wired to 5% via blue/green flag. Metrics streaming to dashboard /dash/equinox/canary.

maria: small sample of the exact routing config I tested locally:
```yaml
routing:
  default: equinox14b-int6
  overrides:
    - predicate: "task == 'longform' or prompt_len > 512"
      route: equinox14b-int8
      pct: 20
    - predicate: "safety_score < 0.6"
      route: equinox14b-fp16
      pct: 2
canary:
  percent: 5
  monitoring: ["nack_rate", "p95_latency", "rouge-l"]
```

jon: quick note on batching tradeoffs — int6 scheduling gives better packing (smaller memory) so batch sizes can be bumped, which helps throughput; but for tail latency we saw ~+18ms at p95 vs int8, likely due to kernel alignment and extra dequant steps.

lee: example longform regression (input simplified): "Summarize this policy doc into 3 bullets and a single-sentence TL;DR."
- fp16 TL;DR: concisely captures goal and constraints.
- int8 TL;DR: mostly fine, missed nuance about scope.
- int6 TL;DR: repeated clause, missed the scope, extra hallucinated step.

product-alex: can we run a 24h canary with 5% traffic routed to int6 + 20% int8 for longform? Need live hallucination metric and human eval samples daily. If int6 holds for transactional slices, we can push to default for chat.

maria: action items:
- jon: run 24h canary with the routing above, add token-cost dashboard and per-route p95/p99 (assigned).
- lee: create 200 longform human-eval samples focusing on coherence/hallucination; run blind eval vs int8/fp16.
- august/product-alex: confirm GTN gating thresholds (acceptable delta ROUGE-L < 1.0? hallucination lift < 0.5%?)
- ops-bot: keep canary flag at 5%, alert on rouge-l drop >1.2 or hallucination rate increase >0.6%

maria: partial recommendation for now: stage the model with default=int6 for chat, override longform->int8 at 20%, fp16 safety fallback 2%. Start canary at 5% with the monitoring hooks above. If human eval of longform shows intolerable regression, hold default and increase longform routing to int8.

jon: ack. I[0m will kick off the 24h canary this afternoon. :thumbsup:

lee: will draft the human-eval batch tonight and share the labeling sheet.

product-alex: sounds good — please ping me in the canary channel when 1% of canary traffic completes, I[0m will pull samples.

maria: thanks all — tagging @jon @lee for next steps. I[0m will consolidate a short scorecard after 24h and post in #product-handbook. :memo:
